newsitem.title: USA: State Street Boston vows independence - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: State Street Boston vows independence - WSJ.

text.p: State Street Boston Corp, facing unwelcome interest from Bank of New York, intends to stay independent, The Wall Street Journal quoted State's chairman as saying.

Bank of New York said last week it plans to double its stake in the bank to just under 10 percent. The move was seen as a step to either force State into merger talks or put it in play, the journal said.
It said State may have a good case for staying independent because a sale could make it difficult to maintain clients and hinder its ability to attract new ones.
